title: Canonical supported continuity at Noetherian localization limits
statement: Use the supported Ext carriers and canonical restriction equations of [def-per-regular-supported-class-operations] and the prime-power coefficients and normalized twist comparisons of [def-per-regular-immersion-class-system]. Define a localization-limit morphism as either a multiplicative-set localization $\operatorname{Spec}S^{-1}R\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, up to isomorphism of source and target, or the geometric strict-localization structural map of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], up to source isomorphism. Define the supported local-continuity predicate as follows. For every small nonempty cofiltered Cartesian diagram of closed Noetherian pairs with affine ambient stages, affine etale transition maps, Noetherian limiting pair, and a limit projection which is such a localization-limit morphism, require in every positive coefficient level, signed twist and nonnegative cohomological degree: every limit supported class is the canonical restriction of a class at some stage; every stage class restricting to zero at the limit restricts to zero along some later arrow. These two conditions express the isomorphism from the filtered colimit under the actual supported comparison maps. This is a definition of the continuity assertion, not a theorem that it holds.

source.place: Expose XVI, section 2.1 (supported Kummer first Chern class), Definition 2.3.1 and Theorem 2.3.2 (regular-immersion class and composition), Proposition 2.2.3.1 (base change preserving conormal data), section 3.2 before Definition 3.2.2 (local and strict-local restriction), coefficient square in Proposition 3.3.1 and compatible cocycles in Proposition 3.3.2. Continuity is the supported version of Stacks Tag 03Q6 (etale-cohomology.tex, lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology); only affine ind-etale localizations of Noetherian pairs are asserted here.
